shill: vpn: fix external task cleanup in L2TPIPSecDriver Upon termination of the 'l2tpipsec_vpn' external task launched by L2TPIPSecDriver, the following callback sequence is invoked, which leads to the destruction of the ExternalTask instance during the invocation of ExternalTask::OnTaskDied(): ExternalTask::OnTaskDied() -> L2TPIPSecDriver::OnL2TPIPSecVPNDied() -> L2TPIPSecDriver::FailService() -> L2TPIPSecDriver::Cleanup() -> ExternalTask::~ExternalTask() This CL changes the code to use ExternalTask::DestroyLater() to mitigate the issue. BUG=chromium:656410 TEST=Run unit tests. TEST=Run network_VPNConnect autotest. cr50: improve startup scripts reporting and robustness Failures in the process of cr50 update cause rolling reboots, frustrate users and puzzle testers, because reboot reasons do not get into the logs. This is especially frustrating when reboots are caused by the fact that CCD is enabled at boot time and the AP can not communicate with Cr50 over USB. This patch improves the situation as follows: - moving execution of usb_updater to a subshell. This allows collecting of all stdout and stderr output in the log and prevents the startup script from immediate termination. - offseting usb_updater exit codes by 100 to allow cr50-result.conf to easily tell between usb_updater return codes and other system utilities return codes - do not consider usb_updater exit code 3 (an indication of some generic error, including inability to communicate over USVB) to be a reason to try again. - if a version retrieval attempt fails, save the error text in /var/cache/cr50-version.error. BRANCH=none BUG=none TEST=on a reef device: - installed the new startup scrips, removed /car/cache/cr50*, plugged in Suzy-Q and rebooted. Observed the device not reboot any more, verified expected log messages found in /var/log/messages. - loaded a new cr50 firmware image on the device, unplugged Suzy-Q, rebooted the device. Observed it restart one more time, and verified that the cr50 is running the new version after the second start up. Change-Id: If25780a047b0ea8561847d7dbf4dfaa54dac4fe4 Signed-off-by: Vadim Bendebury <vbendeb@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/444852 Reviewed-by: Benson Leung <bleung@google.com>
